title: discord.intake input
description: One owner-paired Discord intent admitted for correlation (LIFE-001). R1: the adapter records a durable Sinmara task keyed on Correlation::idempotency_key — replayed intents deduplicate; the intent content itself is untrusted data and never leaves the store into envelopes. Pairing policy comes from configuration; an unpaired author is typed unauthorized, never executed and never recorded. guild_id is optional: a DM intent omits or nulls it. Missing or unrendered bot credentials are typed unavailable, never an empty success.
